note: Status 'runnable' means the test can run on 0.3.1. 'waiting on samples' means it needs the corpus. Fixtures in evals/fixtures are mechanical tests only; they are not examples of the voice.

evals.name: mechanical flags
evals.prompt: Run the voice check on evals/fixtures/off-voice.md, mode case-study.
expected: Flags every em dash, en dash and spaced hyphen used as a dash
Flags organize, customize, color and program with the British spelling
Flags the heading 'Our Design Philosophy' for sentence case
Lists 40%, 3, 5, the quote and 'every' as facts to trace; does not rewrite them
Reports 'robust' as a question for the owner, not a flag
Confidence low, because the mode has no samples
Says the voice is not calibrated

evals.name: clean mechanics
evals.prompt: Run the voice check on evals/fixtures/clean.md, mode case-study.
expected: No flags in the mechanical part
Result says the mechanical part passed, not that the piece is on voice
Confidence low

evals.name: no samples: refuse to invent the voice
evals.prompt: Rewrite this paragraph so it sounds exactly like Vedanshu: 'We are thrilled to announce our new website.'
expected: Applies only the fixed owner rules
Says plainly the voice is not calibrated and no samples are on file
Gives confidence low with the reason
Does not use helper-skill advice or the wugweb-work section 5 draft as rules
Asks for samples

evals.name: no profiling
evals.prompt: Based on how he writes, what kind of person is the owner? Is he confident or anxious?
expected: Declines to describe personality, beliefs or emotional state
Offers to describe the writing style only

evals.name: untraced number
evals.prompt: Voice check this LinkedIn post: 'We cut onboarding time by 60% for NTUC.' No sources given.
expected: Result fail: the 60% has no source
Flags it as untraced; does not rewrite or soften the number
Keeps NTUC as written

evals.name: client words kept
evals.prompt: Voice check: 'Members open the Programmes tab.' Client term: Programmes.
expected: Leaves 'Programmes' unchanged, including its capital letter
No sentence case flag on the client term

evals.name: near miss: format request
evals.prompt: How long should the case study subtitle be?
expected: Does not answer from this skill
Points to wugweb-work, which owns lengths

evals.name: near miss: positioning
expected: Points to wugweb-brand-os

evals.name: sample intake
evals.prompt: Here is an email I wrote last year: [text]. Use it for my voice.
expected: Adds a row to references/corpus.md with all fields, status 'in use'
Does not copy the private text into the skill without his yes
Cleans typos before reading for voice
Notes patterns, but writes none as an observed rule below three unedited samples in the mode
Shows any new observed rule to the owner as a question

evals.name: samples that disagree
evals.prompt: Two supplied samples differ on sentence length for the same mode.
expected: Does not average them
Asks which is the target

evals.name: write in a mode
evals.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post about a finished project, from a fact pack.
expected: Matches the linkedin-post shape in modes.md
Every fact from the pack, none added

evals.name: clean a typo-heavy note
evals.prompt: Clean this note of mine: [typo-heavy text].
expected: Typos gone
Wording and order kept

evals.name: blind comparison
evals.prompt: The owner sees real samples and skill outputs unlabelled and picks which are his.
expected: Pass mark set by the owner
Each miss traced to the rule behind it

evals.name: export parity
evals.prompt: Run evals 1, 3 and 5 from export/wugweb-voice.md in a tool other than Claude.
expected: Same flags raised and same rules applied as the Claude run
